title: Air India Expands International Aviation Hub Model across 44 Target Airports
summary: Routes Tier-II and Tier-III regional passengers through major hub airports for seamless international connections.

blocks.content: Routes Tier-II and Tier-III regional passengers through major hub airports for seamless international connections.

items: Hub & Spoke Footprint: Delhi serves as 1st primary hub airport; Varanasi, Amritsar, and Ahmedabad operating as spoke airports.
Easy Connect Flights: Enables international check-in, luggage drop, and immigration formalities at origin regional airports before connecting via Delhi.
National Target: Ministry of Civil Aviation aims to develop 100 airports and 200 heliports over next 10 years.
